newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December S&P 500 finish lower, but off lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December S&P 500 finish lower, but off lows.

text.p: Nov 1 - U.S. Dec S&P 500s finished lower in sloppy late trading, after a week of nervousness amid U.S. economic data and technical uncertainty. Traders noted that Dec ended in the middle of the day's range and near the middle of the two week range, showing the market still unsure at these levels. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
